name: Lisa Blunt Rochester

issue_poll.name: University of Delaware CPC/YouGov Delaware poll, Sept 11–19, 2024; Gallup national vote-issues poll, Sept 16–28, 2024
issue_poll.note: The UD poll published only three issues (economy 88%, abortion 69%, immigration 66% most/very important), so those rank 1–3. Ranks 4–10 come from Gallup's national list by % extremely important (https://news.gallup.com/file/poll/651749/2024_10_09_Vote%20Issues%20Topline%20and%20Tabs.pdf).

issues.position: Ease zoning to build more housing; curb grocery price gouging

votes.question: Motion to concur in House amendment with an amendment

issues.note: Housing act includes zoning and planning grants; no floor vote on price gouging.

issues.position: Codify Roe v. Wade; protect IVF access
issues.note: No Senate floor vote on restoring abortion rights or IVF this term.

issues.position: Comprehensive reform: citizenship path plus border agents and technology
issues.note: No floor vote on comprehensive reform; enforcement-only votes not counted.

issues.position: Enshrine federal voting rights protections; pass John Lewis bill
issues.note: Rated on votes against new voting requirements; the John Lewis bill got no floor vote.

Build on student loan forgiveness; fund vocational education

votes.question: Cloture on the motion to proceed

issues.note: H.R.1 cut Medicaid; S.3385 would have extended ACA tax credits.
